entries.en: Ann seems to be thinking[n]about something...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Back when I met Shiho,[n]when she saved me...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I realized that personal[n]relationships are something[n]to be treasured.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's why I'm not going[n]to run away anymore.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'll face myself head on.[n]This time, it's my turn[n]to help someone.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But... I'm still kinda worried.[n]Do you think you could help[n]me, [fName]?
Of course.[clr 27]
Ask me anything.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mm-hm!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You can lean on me too, if you need it...
I will.
I already am.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Good!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *giggle*

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...I feel like we finally see each[n]other eye to eye, [fName].

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm so glad I met you...
I feel a strong bond between me and Ann...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I can sense a new power growing within me!
Ann's Persona [clr 1]Carmen[clr 27] has[n]transformed into [clr 2]Hecate[clr 27]!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That doesn't mean I'm gonna stop[n]counting on you. After all, you're[n]an eternal member of my fan club!
What's that?
Eternal?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It means forever! Got it?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, let's eat before our food gets cold!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Time to dig in!
